**shipLane reconciles a push-succeeded PR-missing retry (#920)**

shipLane() split the single commit===null&&ahead===0 escape into two independent questions: pendingPush and delivered (via a new content-containment surveyDelivery(), never commit ancestry, since auto-merge is hardcoded --squash on both providers). A retry that collects zero new records now still runs findOrCreatePr + mrAutoMerge whenever the lane is not yet delivered, fixing audit finding M1 (push landed, mrList outage, retry skipped the PR forever). The outcome shape gains delivered, deliveredReason, and reconciled on every return path; day-start-sweep and memory:ship's own CLI line now report a reconciliation-without-a-push as work, never nothing. The R10 follow-up (cross-day unreconciled lanes) is out of scope, filed as #936 and referenced from the split-predicate's own comment; #930 tracks the VCS port's missing merge-state shape.
